Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

No horses are mirrors.

Some lizards are horses.

Conclusions:

(I) Some horses are not lizards.

(II) Some lizards are not mirrors.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

No horses are mirrors.

Some lizards are horses.

The least possible venn diagram of given statement is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09b140d43e04e2131c709605b0e0f6206eab305d4cd8bc169c1edbe5ba51ad99.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some horses are not lizards - False (Because, Some horses are lizards, it implies that no negative relation is given of lizards and horses, so it can be possible only).

(II) Some lizards are not mirrors - True (Because, No horses are mirrors and Some lizards are horses, it implies that the part of lizards in horses can never be mirrors).

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
